scholarshipName: PEC-PG — Programa de Estudantes-Convênio de Pós-Graduação (Mestrado pleno)
provider: CAPES / CNPq, with Ministério das Relações Exteriores (Divisão de Temas Educacionais)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE — YES, VERIFIED. Edital 12/2025 (PEC-PG) lists '29 Países participantes da África: África do Sul, Angola, Argélia, Benin, Botsuana, Burkina Faso, Cabo Verde, Camarões, Costa do Marfim, Egito, Etiópia, Gabão, Gana, Guiné Bissau, Guiné Equatorial, Mali, Marrocos, Moçambique, Namíbia, Nigéria, Quênia, República Democrática do Congo, República do Congo, São Tomé e Príncipe, Senegal, Tanzânia, Togo, TUNÍSIA e Zâmbia' — quoted verbatim from a Fiocruz institutional briefing document on Edital 12/2025 that reproduces the edital's own text. Full candidate requirements quoted from clause 9.2 of the edital: 'I - ser estrangeiro, nacional de país participante do Programa; II - não ter nacionalidade brasileira, nem dupla nacionalidade brasileira, nem direito a nacionalidade brasileira no momento da inscrição; III - não ser portador de autorização de residência permanente para o Brasil; IV - comprovar conclusão de curso que, no sistema brasileiro, seja considerado equiparável a graduação; V - RESIDIR NO EXTERIOR, EM PAÍS PARTICIPANTE DO PROGRAMA; VI - não estar realizando no Brasil curso no mesmo nível de estudo pretendido; ... IX - ter CURRÍCULO LATTES atualizado; X - ter cadastro na plataforma ORCID; XI - ter cumprido interstício...'. Clause 9.4 adds, for Mestrado Pleno: 'I - não possuir título de mestre ou doutor; II - não ter sido contemplado por entidade pública federal com bolsa de Mestrado Sanduíche ou Mestrado Pleno'. THE CANDIDATE MEETS ALL OF THESE. Note the two administrative chores: he must create a CURRÍCULO LATTES (the Brazilian CNPq academic CV platform) and an ORCID before applying.
ageLimit: No age limit stated in the sources reached. UNVERIFIED.
subjectScope: All subject areas — any programme in the CAPES-evaluated stricto sensu postgraduate system, including music/arts programmes (Brazil has strong PPGs in Música with computer-music/sonology lines, e.g. UNICAMP, UFRGS, UFMG, UNESP).
coverage: Monthly stipend, health-insurance allowance, and MRE-funded return airfare to the country of origin on completion. EXPLICITLY NOT COVERED (edital clause quoted): 'hospedagem de qualquer natureza, no exterior ou no Brasil, inclusive sob a forma de auxílio instalação; auxílio para cônjuge, dependentes ou familiares dos bolsistas; e qualquer espécie de taxa acadêmica e administrativa, para a IES brasileira' — i.e. no housing allowance, no settling-in grant, no family support. Brazilian public universities charge zero tuition regardless. Note the outbound flight to Brazil is not listed; only the auxílio retorno is.
deadline: For the 2026 intake cycle: applications 14 August – 29 September 2025 (one source cites an extension to 8 October 2025); final results 17 December 2025; studies begin first semester 2026. The equivalent 2027-intake call should therefore open around August 2026 and close around late September / early October 2026 — i.e. roughly NOW for a September 2027 start, though note Brazilian academic year starts in MARCH, so a 'September 2027' target maps to the March 2027 or March 2028 Brazilian intake. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
howToApply: Online only at https://inscricao.capes.gov.br/ . Contact inscricao.pecpg@capes.gov.br . No embassy step for the CAPES modality (the CNPq doctorate modality historically routed via embassies).
requiresAdmissionFirst: NO — CORRECTED. The process is: (1) Brazilian PPGs declare available places to CAPES; (2) CAPES publishes the list of vagas (by 13 August for mestrado/doutorado pleno in the 2026 cycle); (3) the candidate registers at inscricao.capes.gov.br choosing a 1st-option and a 2nd-option PPG; (4) the PPGs then select in successive rounds (1ª rodada 30/09–07/10, 2ª rodada 08–15/10, 3ª rodada 16–23/10 in the 2026 cycle) and issue a technical opinion on each candidate. So there is NO separate prior admission step — but the candidate should still contact target PPGs early, since the PPG makes the selection. Applications are accepted in PORTUGUESE, SPANISH OR ENGLISH.
notes: Edital 12/2025. 650 places: 200 MESTRADO PLENO (up to 24 months, start 1st semester 2026), 100 doutorado pleno (48 months), 350 doutorado-sanduíche (6-10 months, start August 2026). Programme began in 2008 and had NO call between 2020 and 2025 (pandemic) — so treat its annual recurrence as likely but not guaranteed. Also 28 participating countries in Latin America/Caribbean, 10 in Asia, 7 in Europe. Application languages: Portuguese, Spanish, English. The CAPES landing page (https://www.gov.br/capes/pt-br/acesso-a-informacao/acoes-e-programas/bolsas/bolsas-e-auxilios-internacionais/encontre-aqui/paises/multinacional/programa-de-estudantes-convenio-de-pos-graduacao-pec-pg) confirms the portal and timetable; gov.br/mec and the edital PDF on gov.br are CAPTCHA-blocked, so the country list was read from the Fiocruz briefing that reproduces it.
verificationStatus: Tunisia eligibility: VERIFIED — 'Tunísia' appears in the 29-country Africa list quoted directly from Edital 12/2025 in a Fiocruz institutional document. The gov.br-hosted edital PDF itself remains UNVERIFIED (CAPTCHA).

scholarshipName: Beca de Excelencia del Gobierno de México para Extranjeros (AMEXCID)
provider: Secretaría de Relaciones Exteriores (SRE) / Agencia Mexicana de Cooperación Internacional para el Desarrollo (AMEXCID)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE — YES. The official 'ANEXO 5 — PAISES ELEGIBLES' annex to the convocatoria lists, under the heading 'AFRICA', item 4: 'LA REPÚBLICA DE TÚNEZ' (2023 annex) and item 5: 'LA REPÚBLICA DE TÚNEZ' (2024 annex). Both annexes were downloaded and read directly. The convocatoria is described as offered to 'más de 170 países, en el marco de convenios bilaterales, de mecanismos multilaterales y de acuerdos especiales'.
ageLimit: Not stated in the annexes retrieved. Historically no hard age cap for the maestría modality but UNVERIFIED for 2026/2027.
subjectScope: All fields, restricted to programmes at the ~90 eligible Mexican HEIs listed in Anexo 1, all registered in the Sistema Nacional de Posgrados (SNP). Mexican SNP includes music/arts posgrados (e.g. UNAM, UdeG, UAM), but whether an electronic-music/music-technology maestría sits on the Anexo 1 list is UNVERIFIED.
coverage: Tuition and registration fees; monthly living stipend (reported at roughly EUR 670/month for maestría, EUR 840 for doctorado); IMSS medical insurance; Mexican visa fee exemption; round-trip international airfare for eligible countries; domestic transport where needed. Stipend figures are from a secondary source — UNVERIFIED against the official convocatoria.
deadline: 2026 cycle: applications closed 22 June 2026, results 6–10 July 2026. The 2027 call should be expected in roughly the same window (the convocatoria has moved around: earlier editions ran July–September). 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
applicationOpens: Varies by edition; the 2026 edition was open in the first half of 2026 (closing 22 June 2026). Earlier editions opened July–September.
howToApply: Online through the SIGCA platform (https://sigca.sre.gob.mx), with documentation submitted through the Mexican Embassy or Consulate accredited to the applicant's country. NOTE: Mexico does not have a resident embassy in Tunis; the concurrent mission would need to be identified — UNVERIFIED which mission handles Tunisia.
requiresAdmissionFirst: YES — a university acceptance letter (carta de aceptación) from an eligible Mexican HEI is one of the required documents. Minimum GPA equivalent to 8.0/10. Spanish proficiency required for Spanish-taught programmes.
notes: Two official annex PDFs were retrieved and read: file/825056 (2023 edition) and file/916003 (2024 edition). Both list LA REPÚBLICA DE TÚNEZ under AFRICA. The 2026-edition annex could not be downloaded — the gob.mx HTML document-listing pages (https://www.gob.mx/amexcid/documentos/becas-de-excelencia-del-gobierno-de-mexico-para-extranjeros-2026) are behind an Akamai bot challenge and returned a 'Challenge Validation' page, and probing for a 2026 Anexo 5 file ID failed. Tunisia's presence in the 2026 annex is therefore INFERRED from two consecutive prior editions, not directly verified. The Anexo 1 (Instituciones Elegibles) 2026 PDF IS reachable at https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/1082428/ANEXO_1_INSTITUCIONES_ELEGIBLES_2026.pdf — check there for any music/arts posgrado. Modalities include full maestría up to 24 months.
verificationStatus: Tunisia eligibility: DIRECTLY VERIFIED in the 2023 and 2024 official annexes; 2026/2027 annex UNVERIFIED.

scholarshipName: Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) — Bilateral Program (Type A), Chinese Embassy in Tunisia channel
provider: China Scholarship Council (CSC) / Ministry of Education of the PRC, administered for Tunisians by the Embassy of the PRC in Tunis and the Tunisian Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur (Direction générale de la coopération internationale)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE AND HAS A BILATERAL EMBASSY CHANNEL — YES. The Embassy of the PRC in Tunisia publishes a dedicated annual notice: 'Avis sur la demande de bourse du gouvernement chinois pour l'année universitaire 2026-2027', which states 'Il est désormais accessible de soumettre une candidature en ligne pour la bourse du gouvernement chinois pour l'année scolaire 2026/2027 jusqu'au 18 février 2026' with the portal 'https://www.campuschina.org/fr/'. The existence of this embassy notice is the operative proof of a bilateral (Type A) quota for Tunisia. Separately, in February 2026 the Tunisian Ministry of Higher Education announced 20 Chinese Government scholarships for the 2026/2027 year for licence, master's and doctoral students of OIC member states including Tunisia.
ageLimit: Age limits are set per study cycle by CSC (typically under 35 for master's applicants). The Tunisian ministry notice refers to 'compliance with age requirements set for each study cycle'. Exact figure for master's UNVERIFIED from a primary CSC page.
subjectScope: All disciplines offered by CSC-designated Chinese universities. Electronic music / music technology exists in China (e.g. Central Conservatory of Music Beijing, Shanghai Conservatory electronic music departments) and these are CSC-designated institutions — but whether a specific programme is available under the Tunisia bilateral quota is UNVERIFIED.
coverage: Tuition fees, accommodation, monthly living allowance, and comprehensive medical insurance for the full duration of study in China ('Frais de scolarité, logement, allocation mensuelle et assurance santé pris en charge').
deadline: 2026/2027 cycle: online CSC application via campuschina.org open until 18 FEBRUARY 2026 (Chinese Embassy in Tunis notice). Separately, for the 20 OIC-linked places the Tunisian ministry dossier deadline was 28 FEBRUARY 2026, with a compulsory CSCA (Chinese Academic Competence Test) sitting on 25 MARCH 2026 registered at https://csca.cn/home . The equivalent 2027/2028 deadlines should fall in the SAME WINDOW — roughly November 2026 (opening) to mid/late February 2027 — for a SEPTEMBER 2027 start. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED but the pattern is stable.
applicationOpens: The embassy notice for the 2026/2027 round was published 15 November 2025, so expect the 2027/2028 notice around November 2026.
howToApply: EMBASSY CHANNEL (Type A / Bilateral Program): apply online at https://www.campuschina.org/fr/ entering the agency number of the Chinese Embassy in Tunisia, and submit the paper dossier to the Embassy (22 Rue Dr. Burnet, Tunis 1002; tel 71780064; chinaemb_tn@mfa.gov.cn) and/or via the Tunisian university → Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur, Direction générale de la coopération internationale. The specific AGENCY NUMBER for the Chinese Embassy in Tunis was NOT found — UNVERIFIED; the applicant must obtain it from the embassy notice attachments. UNIVERSITY CHANNEL (Type B) also exists in parallel: apply directly to a CSC-designated Chinese university with the university's own agency number; this does not require a national quota and is generally the more accessible route for a candidate with no ministry backing.
requiresAdmissionFirst: For the embassy/bilateral route, a pre-admission letter is strongly advised and the Tunisian ministry notice explicitly requires 'prior admission to one of the Chinese scholarship programs'. For the university route, admission and scholarship are decided together by the university.
notes: The embassy also warns: it has established no paid consulting service for study/scholarship applications and has authorised no third-party agency — Tunisian students should not use paid agents. Corroborating Tunisian coverage of the 20 OIC places: https://www.leconomistemaghrebin.com/2026/02/24/chine-20-bourses-pour-etudiants-tunisiens-oci-en-2026-2027/ . Note that the 20 OIC-linked places are a DIFFERENT, narrower scheme from the general bilateral CGS quota. Tunisia–China talks in August 2026 reportedly discussed increasing/doubling the number of scholarships for Tunisian students. Language: Chinese or English proficiency required; the CSCA test was made compulsory for the OIC scheme in 2026.
verificationStatus: Tunisia has an embassy channel: DIRECTLY VERIFIED from the Chinese Embassy in Tunis. Agency number and exact quota size for the general bilateral programme: UNVERIFIED.

scholarshipName: PAEC OEA-GCUB — Programa de Alianzas para la Educación y la Capacitación (Becas Brasil)
provider: Organization of American States (OAS/OEA) + Grupo Coimbra / GCUB (Grupo de Cooperação Internacional de Universidades Brasileiras)
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS NOT ELIGIBLE — NO. PAEC is restricted to citizens and/or permanent residents of OAS Member States (34 countries of the Americas), excluding Brazil. Tunisia is not an OAS member state, and no African country is. Quoted eligibility as published: 'You must be a citizen and/or permanent resident of any OAS Member State, except for Brazil.' RULE THIS SCHEME OUT.
subjectScope: Master's and doctoral (stricto sensu) programmes at participating Brazilian universities; ~258 places in the tenth edition.
coverage: Tuition waiver at the Brazilian host university plus, in some cases, a maintenance stipend; the candidate normally covers airfare and visa costs.
requiresAdmissionFirst: No — applicants select programmes from the GCUB catalogue within the call.
notes: NEGATIVE FINDING, recorded deliberately. The GCUB website itself (gcub.org.br) returned HTTP 403 to automated fetching, so the eligibility clause is taken from the OAS scholarships page and from institutional restatements (UFJF international office, UFC). The 'OAS Member States only' rule is structural to the programme (it is an OAS partnership), not a year-specific restriction, so this is a firm no. THE USEFUL ALTERNATIVE IS GCUB-Mob — see the separate record.
verificationStatus: Tunisia ineligible: high confidence (structural OAS membership rule); gcub.org.br primary page UNVERIFIED (403).

scholarshipName: GCUB-Mob — Programa GCUB de Mobilidade Internacional (Bolsas de Mestrado)
provider: Grupo de Cooperação Internacional de Universidades Brasileiras (GCUB), with support of the Brazilian Ministério das Relações Exteriores and CAPES
whoCanApply: TUNISIA APPEARS ELIGIBLE — YES (open-list scheme, not a closed country list). The edital's general requirements, read verbatim from the official PDF of Edital GCUB-Mob Nº 001/2025, are: '3.1. Requisitos gerais para inscrições: a. Apresentar candidatura em português, inglês, espanhol ou francês. b. SER CIDADÃO(Ã) DE ESTADO QUE MANTENHA RELAÇÃO DIPLOMÁTICA COM O BRASIL. c. Não possuir nacionalidade brasileira. d. Declarar que está em boas condições de saúde (física e mental) para realizar estudos de pós-graduação. e. Ter capacidade para financiar despesas extras não cobertas pela bolsa, por exemplo: passagem aérea, processamento [de visto]...'. There is NO closed annex of countries: the programme is described as 'destinadas a estudantes internacionais provenientes dos CINCO CONTINENTES'. Tunisia maintains full diplomatic relations with Brazil, so a Tunisian national qualifies. IMPORTANT PRACTICAL POINT: applications may be submitted IN FRENCH.
ageLimit: None stated in the edital text read.
subjectScope: Master's and doctoral programmes across the participating Brazilian universities, per the 'Tabela de Mestrados e Doutorados das IES brasileiras' published with each call. The 2026 edition offered 889 places (539 master's, 350 doctoral) across 62 Brazilian universities. Whether any of them is a music-technology / electronic-music master's is UNVERIFIED — the programme table must be checked when the call opens.
coverage: 'a. Isenção do pagamento de matrículas, mensalidades ou anuidades acadêmicas referentes ao programa de estudos para o qual foi selecionado(a). b. Bolsa de estudo: Mestrado: Bolsas mensais, tendo como referência mínima o valor pago pelas agências [de fomento brasileiras]' — i.e. full tuition waiver plus a monthly stipend benchmarked to the standard Brazilian funding-agency master's rate. AIRFARE AND VISA COSTS ARE NOT COVERED (requirement 3.1.e explicitly requires the candidate to be able to fund them).
deadline: 5th edition (GCUB-Mob Nº 001/2026): applications closed 6 July 2026, for studies beginning in 2027. 4th edition timetable read from the edital PDF: applications 26/03/2025 – 09/05/2025, results published 03/10/2025. A 6th edition for a 2028 start would be expected around March–July 2027. NOTE: this means the 2026 call — the one aligned to a 2027 start — HAS ALREADY CLOSED (6 July 2026).
applicationOpens: Varies: late March in the 4th edition, spring in the 5th edition.
howToApply: Free online application through the GCUB portal (https://www.gcub.org.br/bsp/). Results published at https://www.gcub.org.br/.
requiresAdmissionFirst: No — candidates choose from the published table of Brazilian master's/doctoral programmes within the call itself; selection is run by GCUB with the host universities.
notes: The eligibility text above was extracted from the official 4th-edition edital PDF (Edital GCUB-Mob Nº 001/2025) mirrored at https://ppgcta.ufc.br/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/edital-gcub-4a-ediCAo.pdf, since gcub.org.br returns 403 to automated fetching. Selection explicitly weights geographic distribution and gives preference to candidates from countries with LOWER Human Development Index ('Considerando os demais critérios, terão preferência os(as) candidatos(as) dos países com menor IDH') — Tunisia has a relatively high HDI for Africa, which is a mild disadvantage. Scholars must return to their country of origin within 30 days of finishing. THIS IS THE BEST BRAZILIAN ROUTE AFTER PEC-PG and the one that does NOT require securing admission first.
verificationStatus: Eligibility clause: DIRECTLY VERIFIED from the official edital PDF (4th edition). 2027-cycle dates UNVERIFIED.

scholarshipName: Global Korea Scholarship — Graduate Degree (GKS-G), Embassy Track
provider: NIIED (National Institute for International Education), Ministry of Education, Republic of Korea
whoCanApply: TUNISIA IS ELIGIBLE — YES, WITH AN EMBASSY QUOTA. The 6-place figure reported by the other agent is CORROBORATED but only from a secondary aggregator: KoreaAdmit's per-country quota table gives Tunisia GKS-U (undergraduate) = 0 places and GKS-G (graduate) = 6 places under the General strand for 2026, stating 'Every figure is transcribed from the official NIIED application guidelines' and citing the '2026 GKS-G Application Guidelines' (NIIED, February 2025) and '2026 GKS-U Application Guidelines' (NIIED, October 2025). I COULD NOT OPEN THE NIIED PDF OR THE KOREAN EMBASSY IN TUNIS PAGE DIRECTLY — the 6-place figure is therefore CORROBORATED BUT NOT PRIMARY-VERIFIED. Overall 2026 GKS-G intake: 2,000 graduate students, 800 via the Embassy Track and 1,200 via the University Track.
ageLimit: Under 40 as of 1 September of the entry year (standard GKS rule) — UNVERIFIED against the 2026/2027 guideline. Also requires having graduated (or being due to graduate) with a bachelor's degree, and a GPA requirement of 80/100 or 2.64/4.0 or top 20% of class.
subjectScope: All fields; the candidate selects up to three universities from the designated GKS university list. Korean universities with electronic music / music technology master's include Korea National University of Arts (K-Arts) and Sungkyunkwan/Kyung Hee-type media-arts departments — whether these appear on the 2027 GKS designated-university list for the Embassy Track is UNVERIFIED.
coverage: Full tuition, airfare, monthly allowance (approx. KRW 1,000,000/month for graduate students), settlement allowance, one year of Korean language training at a designated institute, medical insurance, and a thesis-printing allowance. Exact 2027 amounts UNVERIFIED.
deadline: 2026 GKS-G cycle: online submission deadline 18:00 (KST) WEDNESDAY 25 FEBRUARY 2026 via studyinkorea.go.kr. 2026 GKS-U (undergraduate) closed 30 September 2025. Expect the 2027 GKS-G deadline in late FEBRUARY 2027. TIMELINE FOR A SEPTEMBER 2027 START: apply February 2027, results through spring/summer 2027, arrive September 2027 for the compulsory one-year Korean language course, degree begins MARCH 2028. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
applicationOpens: Typically the guideline is published by NIIED in late January/February and the embassy window opens immediately after.
howToApply: EMBASSY TRACK: apply to the Embassy of the Republic of Korea in Tunis with the full NIIED application pack; the embassy screens and nominates against Tunisia's quota. UNIVERSITY TRACK: apply directly to one designated Korean university (only one may be chosen), which nominates to NIIED — this track has 1,200 places globally and is NOT constrained by Tunisia's 6-place embassy quota, so it is worth pursuing in parallel. Official portal: https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr . NEW DETAIL: the Korean Embassy in Tunisia's contact address for GKS applications is reported as tunisie@mofa.go.kr. In the 2026 cycle ALL GKS-G documents, including the application form, were submitted ONLINE through https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr with a hard deadline of 18:00 KST, Wednesday 25 FEBRUARY 2026 — GKS-G has moved to online submission rather than paper-to-embassy, so check the 2027 guideline for the current mechanism.
requiresAdmissionFirst: No — GKS selection precedes and determines university placement; the applicant lists university/department preferences within the GKS application.
notes: The 6 GKS-G places for Tunisia is a plausible and specific figure and matches the shape of NIIED's North-Africa allocations, but it comes from an aggregator. BEFORE RELYING ON IT, the applicant should download the '2027 GKS-G Application Guidelines' from https://www.studyinkorea.go.kr (Notice board) when published, and check Appendix 'Available Countries and Quota', and cross-check with the Korean Embassy in Tunis. Note the compulsory Korean-language year makes the effective commitment 3 years for a 2-year master's, and note that a 'September 2027' target only reaches the language course, not the degree. ADDITIONAL: mofa.go.kr and overseas.mofa.go.kr return 503 from this environment, so no Korean-government page could be opened directly. GKS 2026 selects 2,000+ students from 155 countries.
verificationStatus: Tunisia has a GKS-G embassy quota: high confidence. The specific figure of 6: CORROBORATED BY ONE AGGREGATOR CITING NIIED, NOT PRIMARY-VERIFIED. NIIED PDF and Korean-embassy-in-Tunis page: UNVERIFIED (not reachable).

institution: École Supérieure de l'Audiovisuel et du Cinéma de Gammarth (ESAC) — Université de Carthage
program: Mastère Professionnel en Sciences et Techniques de l'Audiovisuel et du Cinéma — parcours SON ET MIXAGE
qualification: Mastère professionnel (national Tunisian master's, LMD, bac+5)
accreditationStatus: Public establishment of the Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche Scientifique, created by décret n°2004-2202 of 14 September 2004, attached to the Université de Carthage. Nationally accredited.
language: French and Arabic (Tunisian public HE; the application notice is issued in Arabic and French).
durationEcts: 2 years (4 semesters), 120 ECTS equivalent under the Tunisian LMD system. ECTS count UNVERIFIED.
whatYouStudy: Sound for cinema and audiovisual: prise de son (location recording), sound editing, mixing, post-production, sound for image. THIS IS THE CLOSEST THING TO THE CANDIDATE'S FIELD THAT EXISTS AT MASTER'S LEVEL IN TUNISIA. It is film/TV sound craft, NOT electronic music composition, NOT music production, NOT sound art. Sister parcours in the same mastère: Image et lumière, Montage. Other ESAC master's: Mastère Professionnel en Cinéma et Audiovisuel (Assistanat à la Réalisation / Production Audiovisuelle); Mastère Professionnel STAC parcours Décor de plateau; Mastère de Recherche en Sciences et Techniques de l'Audiovisuel et du Cinéma.
entryRequirements: A licence (licence fondamentale or licence appliquée) or equivalent. ESAC's undergraduate entry is by concours reserved for holders of the bac, a first-cycle university diploma, or a licence. For the mastères, selection is on dossier via an online form, per the annual notice. THE EXACT LIST OF ACCEPTED LICENCES IS UNVERIFIED — the selection criteria live in an attached PDF that could not be retrieved (esac.rnu.tn and esac-gammarth.com are unreachable from this environment).
acceptsNonMusic: UNVERIFIED and the single most important open question. Tunisian mastères professionnels normally list the licences 'habilitées' to apply; a Licence/BSc in Software Engineering would be an unusual profile for a Son et Mixage cohort but is not obviously excluded, and the candidate's coding background is genuinely relevant to audio. ADDITIONAL RISK: the candidate's degree is from SMU / Med Tech, a PRIVATE Tunisian university — admission to a public mastère normally requires the private diploma to be recognised (diplôme homologué/équivalence) by the Ministry. This must be checked before anything else.
portfolioSpec: Not stated in the public notices retrieved. UNVERIFIED.
auditionSpec: Not stated; selection appeared to be dossier-based with an online Google Form in the 2022-23 and 2025-26 rounds. Interview/test UNVERIFIED.
tuitionNonEU: Tunisian public higher education: no tuition; only the annual registration/inscription fee (a nominal sum in dinars). EXACT FIGURE UNVERIFIED.
otherFees: Student social security / mutuelle and inscription administrative fees. UNVERIFIED.
totalCostEstimate: Effectively living costs only for a resident Tunisian. No visa, no relocation, no language barrier — this is the cheapest option in the entire sweep by an order of magnitude.
scholarshipName: Bourse universitaire nationale (Tunisian state student grant) — means-tested, applies to Tunisian nationals in public HE.
scholarships: National bourse and student housing (foyer) through the Office des Œuvres Universitaires. Eligibility and amounts UNVERIFIED.
languageRequirement: None beyond French/Arabic, both of which the candidate has natively or fluently.
deadline: 2025-2026 round: applications ran 28 May 2025 – 20 JUNE 2025. 2022-2023 round: opened 28 June 2022, closed 12 August 2022. FOR A SEPTEMBER 2027 START the equivalent window would be roughly MAY–JULY 2027. 2027 dates UNVERIFIED.
applicationOpens: Late May to late June, depending on the year.
notes: VERIFIED VIA: the Orientini 2025-2026 and 2022-2023 candidature notices, which both enumerate 'Master Professionnel en Sciences et Techniques de l'Audiovisuel et du Cinéma (Image et lumière, SON ET MIXAGE, Montage)'. ESAC's own domains (esac.rnu.tn, esac-gammarth.com) return 503 / DNS failure from this environment, so the institutional page could not be read directly. Contact: esac@rnu.tn, +216 71 981 441, 20 Avenue Farhat Hached, La Marsa-Safsaf 2078, Gammarth.

institution: Institut Supérieur de Musique de Tunis (ISMT) — Université de Tunis
program: Mastère de recherche en Musique et Sciences Musicales / Musique et Interprétation (ماجستير البحث في الموسيقى والعلوم الموسيقية أو الموسيقى والأداء)
qualification: Mastère de recherche (research master's), leading to the Doctorat en Musique et Musicologie
accreditationStatus: Public establishment of the Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur, founded 1982, attached to the Université de Tunis. Nationally accredited.
whatYouStudy: Musicology, music history, analysis, organology, ethnomusicology; or performance (interprétation) of Arab/Tunisian music. ISMT hosts a national research laboratory oriented to 'culture and modern technologies'. NO ELECTRONIC MUSIC, NO PRODUCTION, NO MUSIC-TECHNOLOGY TRACK IS ADVERTISED AT MASTER'S LEVEL. ISMT's undergraduate offer at Tunis is the Licence en Musique et Sciences Musicales only — the sound-engineering licences sit at Sousse and Sfax, not Tunis.
entryRequirements: A licence in music/musicology or a closely related discipline; the selection criteria are published in an attached document each year. UNVERIFIED which licences are admitted.
acceptsNonMusic: ALMOST CERTAINLY NO. This is a musicology/performance research master's for graduates of the licence en musique et sciences musicales; a software-engineering licence with no conservatoire training and no portfolio is not a realistic profile. Recorded as a negative for this candidate.
portfolioSpec: Not published. For the 'Musique et Interprétation' strand a performance audition would be expected. UNVERIFIED.
tuitionNonEU: Public Tunisian HE — registration fee only. Figure UNVERIFIED.

notes: ismt.rnu.tn returns 503 from this environment; the University of Tunis establishment page confirms the institute but lists no programmes. Contact: contact@ismt.rnu.tn, +216 71 257 526, 20 Rue de Paris, 1000 Tunis.

The institute's own stated objectives are to train graduates 'capables de contribuer au développement des activités musicales et sonores liées aux nouvelles technologies', to 'développer des compétences de haut niveau dans le domaine de l'audio et intégrer les nouvelles technologies dans le domaine de la production sonore', and to deepen analysis techniques 'through new tools involving computer expertise and media technologies'. Stated débouchés include 'musique et nouvelles technologies' and production for radio, TV, theatre, cinema and live performance. whatYouStudy: Nothing in scope. The only private-sector provision found in Tunisia at ANY level is: (1) APAC (Académie Pilote des Arts et de la Création) — a BTP (Brevet de Technicien Professionnel) in Audiovisuel, option 'Techniques et production du Son', covering location recording, sound editing and mixing, sound illustration, sound reinforcement and studio work. The APAC BTP is nonetheless worth knowing about as a cheap, local, hands-on way for the candidate to BUILD THE PORTFOLIO he currently lacks — which is the binding constraint on every overseas option in this sweep.

title: BOTTOM LINE ON TUNISIA — does a mastère in this field exist?
answer: ONE, AND ONLY ONE, AND IT IS NOT ELECTRONIC MUSIC. The single Tunisian master's degree with sound at its centre is the MASTÈRE PROFESSIONNEL EN SCIENCES ET TECHNIQUES DE L'AUDIOVISUEL ET DU CINÉMA, PARCOURS 'SON ET MIXAGE', at the École Supérieure de l'Audiovisuel et du Cinéma de Gammarth (ESAC), Université de Carthage. It is public, effectively free, in French/Arabic, needs no visa, and runs a May–June application window. It teaches film and television sound craft — location recording, editing, mixing, post-production — not electronic music composition, not music production, not sound art, and not creative coding for audio.
secondBest: The Mastère de Recherche en Musique et Musicologie at the Institut Supérieur de Musique de Sfax is the only other Tunisian master's whose published objectives mention sound technology ('développer des compétences de haut niveau dans le domaine de l'audio et intégrer les nouvelles technologies dans le domaine de la production sonore'; débouchés in 'musique et nouvelles technologies'). It is nonetheless a musicology research degree.
structuralFinding: Tunisia has built REAL undergraduate capacity in this field and then stopped. At licence level the country offers: Licence en Ingénierie du Son et Nouvelles Technologies (ISM Sfax); Licence en Ingénierie et Techniques du Son, Licence appliquée en INFORMATIQUE MUSICALE, Licence appliquée en Techniques de prise de son, Licence en Musique — métiers du son (ISM Sousse); applied licences in multimédia and SON (ISAMM Manouba); Technologies de l'Image et du Son at ISMAC Rabat next door in Morocco; and a BTP in Techniques et production du Son at APAC. NONE of these has a master's built on top of it inside Tunisia except ESAC's Son et Mixage. There is no Tunisian mastère in electronic music, music production, sound design, computer music, or sound art — none at ISM Tunis, Sfax, Sousse or Kairouan, none at ISBAT/ISBAS/ISBAN, none at ISAMM, none at any private university.
criticalWarning: THE CANDIDATE'S LICENCE IS FROM SMU / MED TECH, A PRIVATE TUNISIAN UNIVERSITY. Admission to any Tunisian public mastère requires the private diploma to carry ministerial recognition/équivalence. THIS SHOULD BE CHECKED WITH THE MINISTÈRE DE L'ENSEIGNEMENT SUPÉRIEUR BEFORE ANY OTHER STEP, because it also conditions several of the overseas routes. Second warning: no Tunisian option found here requires a portfolio, which means none of them fixes the candidate's actual gap — he arrives at September 2027 with no body of work either way.
whatWasCheckedAndFoundEmpty: Institut Supérieur de Musique de Tunis (musicology/performance research master only); ISM Sfax (Musique et Musicologie research master only); ISM Sousse (Interprétation de la Musique Arabe research master only); ISM Kairouan — NO EVIDENCE OF ANY MASTER'S FOUND, and no evidence the institute has a master's habilitation, UNVERIFIED; ISBAT (9 master's, all visual/design); ISBAS (photography, ceramics, plastic arts); ISBAN (master's exist, specialities UNVERIFIED); ISAMM (media engineering, digital concept art, IMD research master — no audio); ESAC (the one hit); Université de Tunis, de la Manouba, de Carthage, de Sfax, de Sousse — no other candidate found; ESPRIT, Université Centrale, ULT, UIK, Time Université, SMU/Med Tech — nothing; Conservatoire national de musique de Tunis / Cité de la Culture — Ministry-of-Culture conservatoire provision, not degree-awarding at master's level, UNVERIFIED; EDIT and ISAJC — COULD NOT BE IDENTIFIED as Tunisian higher-education establishments from any search, so NOT VERIFIED EITHER WAY.
notes: MAJOR METHODOLOGICAL CAVEAT: almost every .rnu.tn domain (the Tunisian academic network) returned HTTP 503 or a TCP reset from this environment, as did esac-gammarth.com and isms.tn. Findings therefore rest on (a) the three .rnu.tn hosts that DID respond — uss.rnu.tn (Université de Sfax), utunis.rnu.tn, uma.rnu.tn — plus (b) Orientini, Tunisia's main orientation portal, which republishes the official candidature notices, and (c) Wikipedia/Marefa/university directory listings. A person inside Tunisia can open these sites directly and should re-check ISM Kairouan and ISBAN specifically.
